given.note: The roster world of commit-s1-04.json (db/seeds/roster-owner.ts, place 1): an owner who named plumbing and electrical at S1-02 answers S1-04's question (oq-s1-04-roster-1, version 1) in words that mean every kind shares one company, and both Haiku reads choose 'All share one' (c-02) with no field; limits 1 to 4 pass and limits 5 and 6 are not checked, as in that fixture. Here the binding hands S1-08's writer no stop reads, as staging's gate did before the stop reads were bound there (README default 199 (5); default 189; T-1516). The walk writes S1-04's rows through S1-04's writer and walks on to S1-08, whose writer cannot rule whether Rosie may text this owner, so it throws notBuilt (stopNotWired naming S1-08: actions/src/tool-api/journey-1/plan/errors.ts lines 34 to 57), and the Tool API base answers notBuilt naming gateAndCommit, its own answer since T-290 (actions/src/tool-api/errors.ts lines 34 to 38; tool-api.ts lines 595 to 598), which v1.13 adopts as K-09's (README v1.13 default 219). Nothing is written: the call's transaction is rolled back, S1-04's rows and the owner's text's safety outcome (No) with it (open gap 207), and oq-s1-04-roster-1 stays open at its version. notBuilt is final (T-1529's ruling 1: 'every notBuilt'; default 217): no retry binds the stop reads, only a deploy does. So the runtime does not resend the call or rerun the turn: it parks the turn at once through K-05 v1.23's parkTurn, with the reason from toolApi, fault notBuilt, ids gateAndCommit, and sends the owner the passedOn line (default 218). The answer names the call alone, never the seam or the step. The turn's ids are this fixture's own stand-ins (README v1.5 default 131), so no other accepted fixture holds its request, and the roster phone's number is never in a file (the handle shown is a fictional one).
